What changed, and why

Returns were locked to the owner

Was

resolve-scan blocked with wrong_requester, the drawer path pinned identity to the owner, and completion returned 403.

Now

Any identified person can return. The owner is shown as custodyOwner (display only). Scans and completion record the real returner, the audit adds returnedForUserId, and the owner's badges stay off the returner's screen. Pickup is still locked to the requester.

Return header didn't say whose gear it was

Was

Only the checkout title.

Now

"Volleyball vs Minnesota · Returning for Imani Brooks" when the returner isn't the owner. See after/kiosk-return-header.png (after-only: this screen was unreachable before).

Plane toggle could never unset

Was

The roster read dropped defaultTraveler, so the card saw undefined and always sent true.

Now

The roster read returns defaultTraveler and only active, visible people.

Travel add trusted the client

Was

Any existing event, any active user (collaborators included), no roster check. A concurrent remove caused a 500, and the audit invented its before value.

Now

Away game with a sport only, not cancelled or combined. Sport-roster members only, no collaborators. P2003 returns 404. A scoped deleteMany makes a concurrent remove quiet. The audit reads the stored before value.

Six one-at-a-time adds per trip

Was

Every away game started empty, even though 4 of 6 travelers are the same every week.

Now

POST /travel/defaults adds every active default traveler, skips anyone already on the trip, and audits once. after/travel-card-defaults-added.png shows the card after the press (stubbed response).

Verification

  • Full vitest: 691 files, 4867 passed (1 skipped), including a new defaults-route suite (5 tests) and a card source-contract test.
  • npx tsc --noEmit, eslint on changed files, npm run build:app, npm run verify:docs, git diff --check: all pass.
  • xcodebuild: Wisconsin on the iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator and WisconsinKiosk on the iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator, both BUILD SUCCEEDED. Kiosk is iPad-only, so the AGENTS.md iPhone destination can't build it.
  • The baseline is an isolated worktree at 5a29ab69 plus identical fixture scenarios. The active checkout was not touched.

Things to know

  • Not proven: a real kiosk return of someone else's checkout on the managed iPad, authenticated web interaction against a real database, and deployment.
  • The return-header capture is after-only. Before this change the flow was blocked before reaching this screen, so there's no honest baseline frame.
  • Older kiosk builds already work with the server change for scan-started returns. The drawer path and the new copy need the TestFlight build.
